def run(scene, robot):
    tub = scene.get("white tub")
    pens = scene.of_kind("pen")
    slots = []
    cursor = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 2.0
    maxd = 0
    for pen in pens:
        eff_w = pen.d if pen.w > pen.d else pen.w
        eff_d = pen.w if pen.w > pen.d else pen.d
        maxd = max(maxd, eff_d)
        cx = cursor + eff_w / 2
        slots.append((pen.name, cx, eff_w, eff_d))
        cursor += eff_w + 1.5
    row_cx = (tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 2.0 + cursor) / 2
    row_w = cursor - (tub.x + tub.w / 2)
    row = (row_cx, tub.y, row_w + 4, maxd + 6)
    pen_names = [p.name for p in pens]
    for o in scene.objects():
        if o.name in pen_names or o.name == tub.name:
            continue
        hit = False
        for name, cx, ew, ed in slots:
            if abs(o.x - cx) < (o.w + ew) / 2 + 2 and abs(o.y - tub.y) < (o.d + ed) / 2 + 2:
                hit = True
        if hit:
            robot.move(o, *scene.free_spot(size=(o.w, o.d), clearance=2.0, avoid=[row]))
    for name, cx, ew, ed in slots:
        pen = scene.get(name)
        t = scene.get("white tub")
        yaw = pen.yaw + 90 if pen.w > pen.d else None
        log(f"moving {name} to {cx}, {t.y} yaw={yaw}")
        robot.move(pen, cx, t.y, yaw)
    robot.home()
explanation: All pens are placed in cleared, side-by-side slots just right of the white tub, using the tub's fresh position so it generalises to other layouts.

def run(scene, robot):
    tub = scene.get("white tub")
    pens = scene.of_kind("pen")
    slots = []
    cursor = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 3.5
    maxd = 0
    for pen in pens:
        ew = min(pen.w, pen.d)
        ed = max(pen.w, pen.d)
        maxd = max(maxd, ed)
        slots.append((pen.name, cursor + ew / 2, ew, ed))
        cursor += ew + 1.8
    row_cx = (tub.x + tub.w / 2 + cursor) / 2
    row = (row_cx, tub.y, cursor - tub.x + 8, maxd + 8)
    names = [p.name for p in pens]
    for o in scene.objects():
        if o.name in names or o.name == tub.name:
            continue
        hit = False
        for name, cx, ew, ed in slots:
            if abs(o.x - cx) < (o.w + ew) / 2 + 3 and abs(o.y - tub.y) < (o.d + ed) / 2 + 3:
                hit = True
        if hit:
            robot.move(o, *scene.free_spot(size=(o.w, o.d), clearance=3, avoid=[row]))
    for name, cx, ew, ed in slots:
        pen = scene.get(name)
        tub = scene.get("white tub")
        if pen.w > pen.d:
            sx, sy = scene.free_spot(size=(pen.w, pen.w), clearance=2, avoid=[row])
            log(f"staging {name} at {sx}, {sy} to rotate")
            robot.move(pen, sx, sy, pen.yaw + 90)
            pen = scene.get(name)
        log(f"placing {name} at {cx}, {tub.y}")
        robot.move(pen, cx, tub.y)
    robot.home()

def run(scene, robot):
    tub = scene.get("white tub")
    pens = scene.of_kind("pen")
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = scene.bounds()
    maxw = max(p.w for p in pens)
    horiz = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 2.5 + maxw <= x1 - 0.5 and robot.can_reach(tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 2.5 + maxw / 2, tub.y)
    slots = []
    if horiz:
        cx = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 2.5 + maxw / 2
        total = sum(p.d for p in pens) + 1.8 * (len(pens) - 1)
        cy = tub.y - total / 2
        for pen in pens:
            slots.append((pen.name, cx, cy + pen.d / 2, pen.w, pen.d))
            cy += pen.d + 1.8
        row = (cx, tub.y, maxw + 6, total + 6)
    else:
        cursor = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 3.5
        maxd = max(max(p.w, p.d) for p in pens)
        for pen in pens:
            ew, ed = min(pen.w, pen.d), max(pen.w, pen.d)
            slots.append((pen.name, cursor + ew / 2, tub.y, ew, ed))
            cursor += ew + 1.8
        row = ((tub.x + tub.w / 2 + cursor) / 2, tub.y, cursor - tub.x + 8, maxd + 8)
    placed = []
    for name, cx, cy, ew, ed in slots:
        pen = scene.get(name)
        if not horiz and pen.w > pen.d:
            sx, sy = scene.free_spot(size=(pen.w, pen.w), clearance=2, avoid=[row])
            robot.move(pen, sx, sy, pen.yaw + 90)
        for o in scene.objects():
            if o.name == name or o.name == tub.name or o.name in placed:
                continue
            if abs(o.x - cx) < (o.w + ew) / 2 + 3 and abs(o.y - cy) < (o.d + ed) / 2 + 3:
                robot.move(o, *scene.free_spot(size=(o.w, o.d), clearance=3, avoid=[row]))
        robot.move(scene.get(name), cx, cy)
        placed.append(name)
    robot.home()

import math

def hd(o):
    return math.hypot(o.w, o.d) / 2

def spot(scene, robot, o, pts, rad):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = scene.bounds()
    best = ((x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2)
    bs = -9999
    for gx in range(int(x0 + rad + 1), int(x1 - rad), 4):
        for gy in range(int(y0 + rad + 1), int(y1 - rad), 4):
            if not robot.can_reach(gx, gy):
                continue
            s = min([math.hypot(gx - q.x, gy - q.y) - rad - hd(q) for q in scene.objects() if q.name != o.name] + [math.hypot(gx - px, gy - py) - rad - 8 for px, py in pts] + [99])
            if s > bs:
                bs = s
                best = (gx, gy)
    return best

def clear(scene, robot, cx, cy, w, d, skip, pts):
    for o in scene.objects():
        if o.name in skip:
            continue
        ex = 7 if o.h > 5 else 3
        if abs(o.x - cx) < (o.w + w) / 2 + ex and abs(o.y - cy) < (o.d + d) / 2 + ex:
            b = scene.get(o.name)
            robot.move(b, *spot(scene, robot, b, pts, hd(b)))

def run(scene, robot):
    tub = scene.get("white tub")
    pens = scene.of_kind("pen")
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = scene.bounds()
    slots = []
    cursor = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 3.5
    maxd = max(max(p.w, p.d) for p in pens)
    for pen in pens:
        ew, ed = min(pen.w, pen.d), max(pen.w, pen.d)
        slots.append((pen.name, cursor + ew / 2, tub.y, ew, ed))
        cursor += ew + 1.8
    if slots[-1][1] + slots[-1][3] / 2 > x1 - 0.5 or tub.y - maxd / 2 < y0 or tub.y + maxd / 2 > y1:
        maxw = max(p.w for p in pens)
        cx = tub.x + tub.w / 2 + 2.5 + maxw / 2
        total = sum(p.d for p in pens) + 1.8 * (len(pens) - 1)
        cy = tub.y - total / 2
        slots = []
        for pen in pens:
            slots.append((pen.name, cx, cy + pen.d / 2, pen.w, pen.d))
            cy += pen.d + 1.8
    pts = [(cx, cy) for name, cx, cy, ew, ed in slots]
    names = [p.name for p in pens]
    placed = []
    for name, cx, cy, ew, ed in slots:
        pen = scene.get(name)
        clear(scene, robot, pen.x, pen.y, pen.w, pen.d, names + [tub.name] + placed, pts)
        pen = scene.get(name)
        if pen.w > ew + 0.1:
            robot.move(pen, *spot(scene, robot, pen, pts, max(pen.w, pen.d) / 2), pen.yaw + 90)
        clear(scene, robot, cx, cy, ew, ed, [name, tub.name] + placed, pts)
        robot.move(scene.get(name), cx, cy)
        placed.append(name)
    robot.home()
